subject.title: Discord plugin does not auto-reconnect after 1006 WS close (forces full gateway restart, kills in-flight turns)

question: Should the next Discord repair require a production-reachable root-cause transition before code changes, or may it accept an instrumented close-handler mitigation for the observed stale reconnect state?
rationale: The related mitigation PR had strong live proof but was rejected because the stale shouldReconnect state was not constructible through public behavior; that is a maintainer proof-bar decision, not a safe autonomous triage guess.

options.title: Require Root-Cause Transition Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a live or harness reproduction shows the real lifecycle transition that disables reconnect, then fix that owner path.

options.title: Accept Instrumented Mitigation
options.body: Allow a bounded close-handler re-arm mitigation if it preserves intentional/fatal close behavior and promotes diagnostics to operational logs.

options.title: Add Operator Fallback Only
options.body: Expose channel-scoped reconnect as a recovery command while leaving automatic recovery work tracked separately.

recommendation.title: Require Root-Cause Transition Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a live or harness reproduction shows the real lifecycle transition that disables reconnect, then fix that owner path.

likelyOwner.reason: This person made the prior maintainer proof-sufficiency call on the directly related abnormal-close PR.
